## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changes and why. Distinguish implemented behavior from planned work.

## Scope and architecture

List module/interface changes, ADRs and any coordination across application/platform ownership.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results, including failures or skipped checks.

## Review considerations

- [ ] Tests and documentation reflect the final change.
- [ ] Approved society rules and agent behavior are preserved, or changes are explicitly identified for review.
- [ ] No secrets, private agent data, legacy history or unapproved license material included.
- [ ] Platform-owned files are untouched or separately coordinated.
